# Cost Estimator

## When to use

Use for `03-cost-estimate.md` and IaC planning.

## Instructions

Start from assessment monthly costs. Separate IaaS, Azure SQL family, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, MySQL Flexible Server, network, monitoring, and contingency assumptions. State that production estimates require Azure Pricing Calculator or Cost Management validation.
